gr_list.description: Onboarding: sektor bazli intent seed + default ayarlar

plan.summary: DB-driven intent architecture: Knowledge service intent READ API, sector intent template seeds (3 sectors x 22 intents), B2B/VIP lead detection, auto-tagging via existing ApplyTag callback, confidence threshold fallback chain.
plan.q_intent: Pkt6a basla — Niche Foundation with 6 GRs (split from 11, remaining deferred to PKT-6B)
plan.interview_notes: Q chose: Split 6A+6B scope, Whisper API (cloud) for voice (deferred), DB-driven intents (recommended). Excluded: multi-turn (GR-3.1.4), API key self-service, wizard UI.

files_changed.change: 22 sector intent seed records (7 eticaret + 6 dis_klinik + 9 estetik)
Typed HTTP client for Knowledge intent fetch with graceful degradation
B2B keyword scanner + vip_flags upsert + sales webhook
Sector template to tenant intent seeding via Knowledge API
+KnowledgeIntentClient/VipDetection DI, +pre-flow intent fetch, +post-flow VIP detection + auto-tag

verification_questions.question: Does every SQL query include tenant_id in WHERE clause for data isolation?
Does KnowledgeIntentClient send JWT Bearer token with every request?
When Knowledge service is down, does Automation gracefully fall back to default intents?
Is B2B keyword matching case-insensitive via ToLowerInvariant?
Is vip_flags upsert idempotent via ON CONFLICT with GREATEST for score?
Does GET /intents/{tid} validate JWT tenant_id claim matches route tenantId?

user_facing_errors: 502 Bad Gateway: Knowledge service seed call failed
403: Token tenant does not match route tenant
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks log with error codes (INV-AT-025/026). KnowledgeIntentClient returns null on failure (logged). VipDetection returns null on failure (logged). No silent swallowing.

aha_moments.user_pain: B2B leads gizli kaliyor, satis ekibi toptan talepleri kaciriyor
aha_moments.suggestion: VIP detection ile otomatik sales webhook tetikleme, aninda lead bildirim
aha_moments.aha_moment: Satis ekibi toptan siparis mesajini aninda gorunce musteri henuz sicakken arayabilir

aha_moments.user_pain: Yeni tenant onboarding'de intent'ler elle tanimlanmak zorunda
aha_moments.suggestion: Sektor bazli tek API cagirisi ile 7-9 intent otomatik seed

aha_moments.user_pain: Hardcoded 5 intent e-ticaret tenant'lari icin yetersiz, iade/iptal intent'leri eksik
aha_moments.suggestion: DB-driven intent mimarisi ile tenant basina 12+ intent, sektor ozel
aha_moments.aha_moment: E-ticaret tenant'i iade talebini ilk kez otomatik algilar, musteri bekleme suresi sifir

aha_moments.user_pain: Detected intent sonrasi müsteriye etiket atanmiyor, CRM'de filtreleme yapılamıyor

aha_moments.user_pain: Dis klinik ve estetik klinikleri icin sektore ozel intent yok, genel intent'ler yetersiz

CQ1.evidence: All endpoints return specific error codes

CQ2.evidence: No silent failures - all catch blocks log with error codes

CQ3.evidence: Minimal diff aligned with plan scope

CQ5.evidence: Null-forgiving operator fixed. Bare catch(Exception) is existing pattern for fire-and-forget

CQ8.evidence: FlowEngineV2 signature change uses defaults, all 3 call sites verified backward compatible

Q1.reasoning: All tenant-scoped queries use tenant_id. sector_intent_templates is by-design global (no tenant FK).

Q2.reasoning: KnowledgeIntentClient.cs:35 sets Bearer auth on every request.

Q3.reasoning: Returns null on all failure modes, orchestrator falls back to defaults.

Q5.reasoning: ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phone) DO UPDATE with GREATEST.

Q6.reasoning: GetValidatedTenant checks JWT tenant matches route.
